thread:
anne: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands — quick follow-up with answers and owners for the Q&A we didn't finish. Recording + slides: https://notion.redwood.ai/all-hands/1820005432 :sparkles:

mike: Can we get a one-line on timeline for Dedicated GA?

anne: Dedicated GA target is still H2 this year; exact date depends on final e2e perf regression checks. Rough window: mid-to-late Q3.

kim: Who owns the rollout cadence for dedicated customers? I can coordinate with infra sales motion.

mike: Owner: @kim will own the customer rollout plan. Action: share a one-pager by next Wed. (AI-1 -> kim) :memo:

jordan: A few folks asked about private deployment (VPC) credential rotation — is there a KB?

devex_jay: There's a draft in docs but needs hardening. I'll PR the KB this week and link here. (AI-2 -> devex_jay) https://confluence.redwood.ai/privacy/vpc-rotation

anne: Quick note on roadmap clarifications from the live Q&A:
- Optimize features (intelligent batching suggestions) stay prioritized for Q3.
- No new paid tiers this quarter; focus is on Dedicated + Private polish.
- We will publish perf baselines for the top 5 models we ship.

mike: Question from the thread: will model rollbacks be automatic on perf regressions?

anne: Short answer: yes for Hosted customers — we have automatic fallback policies configured that will revert to the previous stable variant if latency or error rates cross thresholds. For Dedicated/Private, rollback is configurable per-customer; sales + SEs will decide defaults.

kim: Can you drop the fallback policy thresholds? Ops wants the concrete numbers for SLOs.

anne: Fallback triggers (hosted): 95th p90 latency > 2x baseline OR error rate increase > 3% sustained for 3 minutes. We'll surface these in the Console docs. (AI-3 -> eng-platform to add to docs)

jordan: Any follow-ups on open-source model licensing questions from legal?

mike: Legal flagged a couple of model license edge cases. We're compiling a short FAQ. Legal contact: @mike (I'll loop James from legal). Expect a doc by EOW. (AI-4 -> mike)

devex_jay: small PR item: can we add a short 'how to reproduce' test harness for latency regressions to the evals repo? I can prototype.

anne: please do — that will help automation. (AI-5 -> devex_jay)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: recording uploaded to all-hands-storage/1820005432/recording.mp4 (sha256: 3b7f...a2c)

kim: I'll post the rollout one-pager in #eng-platform and loop sales.

mike: Two quick asks for owners: keep updates to single-threaded comments (one-line status) and mark done with [DONE]. Helps leadership scan.

anne: Thanks — here's the compact action list we promised: 
- AI-1 | kim | One-pager: Dedicated customer rollout plan | due: next Wed
- AI-2 | devex_jay | VPC credential rotation KB PR | due: Fri
- AI-3 | eng-platform | Add fallback triggers to Console docs | due: 2 weeks
- AI-4 | mike | Licensing FAQ with legal | due: EOW
- AI-5 | devex_jay | Latency regression test harness prototype | due: 2 weeks

mike: I'll collect updates on Friday and post a single-thread status. Thanks all :thumbsup:

anne: If anyone asked a question and didn't see it here, DM me or drop it in this thread. Appreciate everyone showing up. :heart:
